4. The concrete constructive opening and its limits.

The supplied elementary controller already supplies return to a finite
analysis-only clean set, weighted occupation of(1+N)^4 from arbitrary
fine states, a rare-intervention bound with the full eta^J factor, and
nominal comparison from the clean set without a rare-atom oracle.
Its guard-return estimates use upper/lower local rates and may be
candidates for pointwise predictable-error estimates. The stationary
cycle argument itself does NOT verify that extension, the all-time
moment hypothesis(3), or the integrable semigroup envelope(2).

An alternative route could construct direct couplings, stronger return
moments or a uniform renewal estimate instead of(2). A physical-time
spectral gap is not imposed by this note. The earlier prefix example
with zero ordinary gap does not refute every weighted envelope or every
augmented controller. Nor does invariance for each frozen coefficient
box supply a common invariant law for changing/adaptive faults.

The full scientific target must construct one fixed elementary design
and paid compiler for all fault rules, or obstruct ALL allowed designs.
Proving only(5), assuming(2)--(3), or treating one controller's failure
would leave that full target open.

network with paths from every double complex to a unary/zero complex.

Those graph conditions and constants are not a universal graph-faithful
compiler or a predictable-fault theorem; inserting arbitrary outflows
can violate the required decoded graph. Exact governing theorem read at
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2209.06988 (PDF identifies v2).

the time-indexed pairwise minorization(NS1) and drift(NS2). It controls
TV/weighted-TV merging of prescribed inhomogeneous Markov kernels.
It supplies neither these network-specific constants nor a direct
history-adaptive target-law conclusion. Governing assumptions/theorem
read at https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0503532.
